column9: TIER-1; queued no_deck; Commerce-platform PM scope (App Store/Google Play/Stripe billing) is a reasonable fit and this specific req has no citizenship/export-control language, but SpaceX is widely reported to require US-Person/ITAR status on many other reqs -- flag for the candidate to re-verify before applying, and never reuse this verdict for a different SpaceX req without re-checking.
